question: The highest point of Andaman and Nicobar islands is called___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saddle Peak**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Saddle Peak is located in the northernmost part of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in India, specifically on North Andaman Island.
 
• It stands at approximately 732 meters (2,405 feet), making it the highest point in the Andaman Islands.
 
• The area around Saddle Peak is known for its lush forests, diverse flora and fauna, and scenic views, attracting nature enthusiasts and trekkers.
 
• The region is part of the Saddle Peak National Park, which is home to several endemic species of plants and animals, including birds and reptiles.

**Semeru**

 
• Semeru is located on the island of **Java in Indonesia** and is part of the **Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park.**
 
• It is the highest mountain in Java, reaching an elevation of approximately **3,676 meters (12,060 feet**) above sea level.
 
• **Semeru is an active stratovolcano**, known for its frequent eruptions and is considered one of the most active volcanoes in Indonesia.
 
• The mountain features stunning landscapes, including lush forests, alpine meadows, and the famous "**Mahameru"** peak, attracting hikers and nature lovers from around the world.

**Teide**

 
• Teide is located on the island of Tenerife in the **Canary Islands, Spain**, and is part of **Teide National Park**.
 
• It is the highest peak in Spain, standing at approximately **3,718 meters** (12,198 feet) above sea level.
 
• The surrounding national park is known for its unique geological formations, diverse ecosystems, and stunning views, making it a **UNESCO World Heritage Site **and a popular destination for tourists and hikers.
